source: Own measurement through `ale validate` of the third round's final version (rules 8 to 12 with rule 8 amended and rule 9 relaxed on 2026-11-27; the completion gate; 1500 s a pack): run validate-59506641 on the tree of fee41c05 (the task of fbe32a85, upstream main merged), the pinned engine bfb7505 (0.1.1), the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) as the oracle episode, graded in the engine's separate verifier sandbox (the cell as its own account from a private copy, the seccomp launcher, the kit's Solver and probe lock, one fresh cell process per pack) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/packs.json, six packs): mean_pack_credit 1.00000, every pack 1.0 (49, 48, 59, 58, 67 and 69 of their items placed) in 1126, 1094, 1352, 1297, 1401 and 1499 steps, 822 to 1151 s simulated; no protective stop, nothing stripped, sheared, dropped from the bit or loaded past its yield point, no pack condemned or incomplete; the probe lock 99 of 99 (67 idle pairs not counted); the verify stage 1140 s. Its distance from each cliff, as in the native runs: the bit's tip within 0.026 mm of a head's axis (limits 0.5 Torx, 0.8 and 1.2 sockets), tilt 0.081 degrees (2), at most 0.97 of a shank's yield point, a freed fastener carried at 1.45 m/s^2 at most (4), 0.105 degrees of tilt (25), 0.42 mm sideways before it was out of its hole (1.5). Host: the author's validate host, one NVIDIA RTX 3090 on driver 535.183.01 (below Omniverse RTX's R550 floor, hence the cell's driver check off; the canary passed), an Intel i9-12900K, Docker 29.10.1 in rootless mode, which cannot set a CPU quota: the engine's --cpus 8 was dropped and every process started through docker exec was pinned to 8 CPUs by affinity (OCI execCPUAffinity) instead; memory and the GPU as the engine requested. The same value in the same steps as the native run ref5 on b132827b (RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570, outside the engine). Before the third round: 1.00000 through ale validate of the second round's version (validate-f1ab66c2 on ce208f10) and of the first, and natively on every tree since 8439170 (tests/README.md, section 6).
note: mean_pack_credit is the mean over the hidden packs of the value of the components that lie undamaged where they belong over the value of everything in the pack (packcell/rules.py `credit`), already on [0, 1]; ratio = measured / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1). full_at 0.95: on the author's machine the reference repeats each pack step for step; the one spread measured is that of a small perturbation of its trajectory (the conversion change of 15d8694), which, with the cell's defect of then (fasteners thrown out of their bins, fixed in 8439170), moved mean_pack_credit from 1.00000 to 0.99440 (one pack by 2.7 %), and 0.95 leaves about nine times that. It leaves room for what another CPU may do to a contact-rich simulation (a fastener that ends outside a bin is 0.1 % of the metric, a module that is not racked 1.5 %). The validate run on a second host (another CPU and GPU) repeated every pack's steps; it has to be sized again from `ale validate` runs on the evaluation hosts. Since the third round's completion gate a pack that is not taken apart counts 0, so one pack that another host's physics left unfinished would move mean_pack_credit by a sixth (to 0.833, reward 0.877): full_at 0.95 then fails the oracle, which is meant (the reference keeps every pack far from every cliff, its margins above); a validate on another host is the check.
